provenance: Extracted from existing local baseline reports and their selected Perf windows; no new performance run was made for this documentation change.
scope: Retained baseline only. Rejected candidate results are excluded. Weights, input video, and full logs are not bundled with this excerpt.

conditions.core_assignment: auto; explicit core masks distributed over cores 0/1/2
conditions.output: H.264 RTSP, TCP ffmpeg client decoding continuously
conditions.clocks: No CPU/NPU clock changes made by runner; NPU current frequency recorded in observations.

metrics.infer_fps: Successful completed tasks/batches divided by the sum of selected window seconds. Composite success may include partial child success.
metrics.publish_fps: Writes accepted by the latest-sequence result slot, not business consumption or client playback FPS.
metrics.queue_worker_ms: Successful-task weighted mean; queue plus inference worker processing, excluding later business/render/network/client playback.
metrics.cpu_percent: Process utime+stime over measurement wall time. 100 percent means one CPU core.
